description: Uses VIVO's speech recognition capability for voice input.
changelog: Improved spoken messages for account information errors, numpad shortcut support, and short recording handling. Removed usernames and raw responses from authentication logs. Thanks to cary-rowen for contributing through PR #2.

translations.description: 调用VIVO的语音识别能力做语音输入。
translations.changelog: 改善账户信息异常时的语音提示、数字小键盘快捷键和短录音处理，移除认证日志中的用户名和原始响应内容。感谢 cary-rowen 通过 PR #2 作出的贡献。
